business_summary: ATS Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the planning, designing, building, commissioning, and servicing of automated manufacturing and assembly systems worldwide. The company offers pre-automation services comprising discovery and analysis, concept development, simulation, and total cost of ownership modeling; post-automation services, including training, process optimization, preventive maintenance, emergency and on-call support, spare parts, retooling, retrofits, and equipment relocation; and contract manufacturing services, as well as after-sales services. It also provides engineering design, prototyping, process verification, specification writing, software and manufacturing process controls development, standard automation products and platforms, equipment design and build, third-party equipment qualification, procurement and integration, automation system installation, product line commissioning, validation, and documentation services. In addition, the company offers value engineering, supply chain management, and integration and manufacturing capabilities, as well as other automation products and solutions; and software and digital solutions comprising connected factory floor management systems to capture, analyze, and use real-time machine performance data to troubleshoot issues, deliver process and product solutions, prevent equipment downtime, drive operational efficiency, and unlock performance for sustainable production improvements. It serves the life sciences, transportation and mobility, consumer products, food and beverage, electronics, nuclear, packaging, warehousing and distribution, and energy markets. The company was formerly known as ATS Automation Tooling Systems Inc. and changed its name to ATS Corporation in November 2022. ATS Corporation was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Cambridge, Canada.
business_summary_ko: ATS Corporation은 자회사와 함께 전 세계적으로 자동화된 제조 및 조립 시스템의 계획, 설계, 구축, 시운전 및 서비스에 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 발견 및 분석, 개념 개발, 시뮬레이션 및 총 소유 비용 모델링으로 구성된 사전 자동화 서비스를 제공합니다. 교육, 프로세스 최적화, 예방적 유지 관리, 긴급 및 긴급 지원, 예비 부품, 개조, 개조 및 장비 재배치를 포함한 자동화 후 서비스; 판매 후 서비스뿐만 아니라 계약 제조 서비스도 제공합니다. 또한 엔지니어링 설계, 프로토타입 제작, 프로세스 검증, 사양 작성, 소프트웨어 및 제조 프로세스 제어 개발, 표준 자동화 제품 및 플랫폼, 장비 설계 및 구축, 타사 장비 검증, 조달 및 통합, 자동화 시스템 설치, 제품 라인 시운전, 검증 및 문서화 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 이 회사는 가치 엔지니어링, 공급망 관리, 통합 및 제조 기능은 물론 기타 자동화 제품 및 솔루션도 제공합니다. 및 공동으로 구성된 소프트웨어 및 디지털 솔루션
